summary.text: Bill Wesley is a Republican member of the Kentucky House of Representatives representing District 91, serving since 2021. The legislature's profile lists Wesley as vice chair of the House Veterans, Military Affairs, & Public Protection Committee and a member of the Natural Resources & Energy and Tourism & Outdoor Recreation committees.

paragraphs.text: According to the legislature's profile, Bill Wesley was born on October 26, 1971, and attended Bluegrass Vo Tech.
The profile lists service in the U.S. Marine Corps and work as a chaplain with the Irvine and Ravenna police departments and the Estill County Sheriff's Department.
It also lists a key to the city of Irvine and a City of Irvine service award.
